description: Search the DataBazaar marketplace for datasets matching a natural-language query, with optional filters for category, price, quality score, and pricing type. Returns ranked listings with prices, quality scores, and checkout URLs. When results are empty, log_data_gap can post a bounty to signal demand to sellers.

category.description: Filter by category: geographic, pricing, sensor, images, text, financial, scientific, social, retail, other

max_price.description: Maximum price in USD — omit to include all prices

query.description: Natural language search query describing the data needed

name: search_datasets
